title: Co-culture of murine bone marrow-derived dendritic cells with OT-I CD8+ T cells for immune activation
author: Jiang, Matzek, et al.
materials: eBioscience™ Foxp3/Transcription Factor Staining Buffer Set

steps.title: Prepare RPMI‑1640 complete medium
steps.instruction: Add 10 % (v/v) fetal bovine serum (45 mL) and 1 % (v/v) penicillin‑streptomycin (5 mL, 10 000 U/mL) to RPMI‑1640 to a final volume of 500 mL; store at 4 °C and warm to 37 °C before use.

steps.title: Prepare dendritic‑cell (DC) medium
steps.instruction: To 495 mL RPMI‑1640 complete medium add 5 mL 10 mM HEPES buffer and 1.75 µL β‑mercaptoethanol (50 µM final) to obtain 500 mL DC medium; store at 4 °C for up to 4 weeks and add freshly prepared mouse GM‑CSF to a final concentration of 20 ng/mL immediately before use (critical for efficient BMDC differentiation). Optional: pre‑dilute the 14.3 M β‑mercaptoethanol stock 1:100 in sterile PBS (0.143 M) and add 175 µL of this dilution per 500 mL to achieve 50 µM.

steps.title: Prepare 0.2 M EDTA‑2Na stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 3.72 g EDTA‑2Na in ~35–40 mL ddH₂O with stirring, adjust pH to 8.0 ± 0.1 using 10 M NaOH, bring to a final volume of 50 mL with ddH₂O, filter through a 0.22 µm filter, and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare FACS buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 97 mL 1× PBS (Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺‑free) with 2 mL fetal bovine serum (2 % v/v) and 1 mL 0.2 M EDTA‑2Na stock (final 2 mM EDTA). Keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare MACS buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 94 mL 1× PBS (Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺‑free) with 5 mL MACS® BSA stock solution (0.5 % w/v) and 1 mL 0.2 M EDTA‑2Na stock (final 2 mM EDTA). Store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Isolate bone marrow cells and start BMDC differentiation
steps.instruction: Harvest femurs and tibiae from a 6–8‑week C57BL/6J mouse, disinfect with 70 % ethanol, remove all soft tissue, and keep bones on ice in sterile PBS. Disinfect bones in 70 % ethanol (3 min) then wash in three wells of DC medium. Using a 20‑gauge needle‑punctured PCR tube, cut the bone ends, place each bone upright in a perforated PCR tube nested in a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, and centrifuge at 10 000 × g for ≤15 s to extrude marrow. Pool marrow suspensions, filter through a 70 µm strainer, centrifuge at 200 × g for 10 min, resuspend pellet in 2 mL DC medium, count cells, adjust to 1 × 10⁷ cells/mL, and seed 1 × 10⁷ cells in 10 mL DC medium containing 20 ng/mL mouse GM‑CSF in a 100 mm non‑TC‑treated petri dish (day 0).

steps.title: Transfect BMDCs with OVA mRNA formulations
steps.instruction: Prepare pre‑warmed DC medium supplemented with 20 ng/mL GM‑CSF. Seed BMDCs at 6 × 10⁵ cells per well in 12‑well plates with 1 mL medium and incubate 12–18 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Treat each well with 90 µL formulation containing 1 µg OVA mRNA: (a) for polymeric nanoparticles, mix 60 µL polymer phase with 30 µL mRNA solution (1 µg) to achieve a 60:1 polymer:mRNA weight ratio, then add 90 µL to the well; (b) for Lipofectamine 2000 control, add 1 µL Lipofectamine 2000 per µg mRNA (total 90 µL). Include carrier‑only and irrelevant‑antigen controls. Incubate 24 h.

steps.title: Isolate CD8⁺ T cells from OT‑I spleen
steps.instruction: Harvest spleen(s) from adult OT‑I mouse (12–24 weeks), place in sterile PBS or RPMI complete medium on ice. Prepare a single‑cell suspension by grinding each spleen through a 70 µm strainer into 3 mL RPMI per well, rinse with 1 mL RPMI, pool up to two spleens, centrifuge 300 × g 10 min, discard supernatant. Lyse red blood cells by adding 10 mL 1× RBC lysis buffer (10× stock diluted 1:10 with ddH₂O), vortex 5 s, incubate 2 min at 20–25 °C, centrifuge 300 × g 10 min, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 2 mL RPMI, count cells. Perform negative magnetic selection using Miltenyi mouse CD8a⁺ T Cell Isolation Kit: (a) place LS column in magnetic separator, rinse with 3 mL MACS buffer; (b) apply cell suspension (≤1 × 10⁸ labeled cells per column, ≤2 × 10⁹ total cells) in 1 mL increments, collect flow‑through (unlabeled CD8⁺ T cells); (c) wash column with 3 mL MACS buffer, collect flow‑through and combine with previous fraction. Keep all steps cold (2–8 °C).

steps.title: Prepare CD8⁺ T cells for co‑culture
steps.instruction: Count isolated CD8⁺ T cells, adjust concentration to 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL in RPMI‑1640 complete medium, and seed 1 × 10⁶ cells per well in 6‑well plates (ready for co‑culture with transfected BMDCs).

steps.title: Optional CFSE labeling of CD8⁺ T cells
steps.instruction: For proliferation assays, centrifuge 2.5 × 10⁷ CD8⁺ T cells at 400 × g for 5 min, resuspend pellet in 2 mL CFSE solution (4 µM in PBS), incubate 15 min at 20–25 °C protected from light, add 12 mL RPMI‑1640 complete medium to quench, centrifuge, discard supernatant, and resuspend cells for immediate co‑culture.

steps.title: Optional purity assessment of CD8⁺ T cells
steps.instruction: Aliquot 1 × 10⁶ cells into two 1.5 mL tubes, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min. Resuspend one pellet in 100 µL FACS buffer (unstained control). Resuspend the other pellet in 50 µL diluted anti‑Mouse CD16/CD32, add 50 µL diluted FITC‑anti‑mouse CD8 antibody, incubate 30 min at 4 °C. Add 1 mL FACS buffer, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min, wash once with FACS buffer, resuspend in 500 µL FACS buffer, and analyze by flow cytometry (Attune NxT) for % FITC‑positive CD8⁺ cells.
